title: Claude Desktop plan-usage history (read-only subset)
description: The subset of Claude Desktop's local plan-usage-history.json that Dejavu reads. Claude Desktop owns this file and its format is not a documented integration contract; consumers must ignore every property not listed here and must never write the file.

version.description: Observed as 2. Not used for selection.

samples.description: Consumers skip malformed entries and use the entry with the greatest t, regardless of array order.

t.description: Capture time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

org.description: Claude organization identifier. Never decoded, stored, or logged by Dejavu.

usage.description: Other keys (for example so, sn, oa, cw, om, op, xu) may appear and are ignored. There is no Fable key and no reset time.
